source.title: U.S. Drought Monitor, county statistics by percent area
source.attribution: The U.S. Drought Monitor is jointly produced by the National Drought Mitigation Center at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, the United States Department of Agriculture, and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration.

method: pct_area values are cumulative (share of county area in that category or worse). level = worst category covering at least 50% of the county; max_level = worst category present anywhere in the county.
